message:
Partial refunds now come out at the right amount. `partialRefund` in `src/payments/partial-refund.js` treats `percent` as 0–100, but it multiplied by the raw percent. It now divides by 100, so a 50% refund of 1250 gives 625 instead of 62500.

`npm test` passes, all 20 tests, including the two in `test/payments-partial-refund.test.js`. I changed only that one line.
